body:
## What

- add observable `createI18n` state through `subscribe()` and `getRevision()`
- add the optional `lino-i18n/react` entry point with `I18nProvider`, locale and translation hooks, `Trans`, `LocaleSelector`, and locale-aware number/date/currency/relative-time formatters
- keep React optional and outside the framework-independent main entry point
- add a minor changeset, public TypeScript declarations, usage documentation, and regression tests
- add the issue 19 case study with a source-backed GT capability inventory, complete requirements matrix, alternatives, risks, and staged plans for extraction, Next/React Native/TanStack adapters, translation automation, caching, and compiler-safe rich JSX

## Why

Issue #19 asks for modern General Translation-style React and framework workflows while keeping `.lino` as the translation source of truth. The runtime previously had no observable mutation contract, so a UI could not safely rerender after locale changes or lazy catalogue loads. This PR establishes that reusable framework boundary and delivers the first React integration layer without coupling React to Node, Bun, Deno, Rust, or future adapters.

## Reproduction and verification

Before this change, `createI18n().subscribe` and the `lino-i18n/react` export did not exist. The new tests reproduce those missing behaviors and verify:

- locale and catalogue mutations notify subscribers while no-op locale sets do not
- unsubscribe prevents later notifications
- provider hooks rerender after locale changes and support nested key prefixes
- scalar and React-element values compose safely in one translated message
- locale selection and `Intl` number formatting follow the active locale
- hooks fail clearly outside the provider

Local checks completed:

- `npm run check`
- `npm test` (42 passed)
- `bun test --timeout 30000` (42 passed)
- `deno test --no-check --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-run` (42 passed)
- `bash scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh`
- `node scripts/check-changesets.mjs`
- `npm run pack:dry-run`
- `cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check`
- `cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- `cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features` (38 passed)

No screenshots are included because this is a runtime/framework API change rather than a visual UI change.

Fixes #19
